notes.tolerance_info: 4e-1 for high resolution mesh, 10 for a coarse mesh. If the point has been projeced on the opposite side increase the tolerance
notes.radius: Maximum search distance for finding the nearest triangles to a point. Set the radius according to the distance between the point grid and the mesh surface.
notes.closed surface: True -> shpere, cilinder or closed surface (very slow). False -> flat, smooth curved surfaces (fast).
notes.preserveboundary: Boolean. Adjust for small circular mesh e.g.g cilinder
